approval_scope: Adopting this mapping does not admit this example Definition or all future pack outputs.
batch_rule: Several Definitions may share a review bundle; each independent target has its own stable Decision core. Partial selection must declare its exact subset and retain open pack obligations.

dispositions.open: Preserve the unresolved obligation. Emit no admission target for that concept; do not claim the whole pack is resolved.
dispositions.propose: Prepare one complete Definition/v2 candidate with explicit supplementary fields and owner review.
dispositions.reuse: Keep an exact current Definition reference. Create no new Definition and no admission target. Applicability still needs review.
dispositions.specialize: If only selecting parameters inside the parent applicability, record a use/application binding. If the normative meaning changes, create a separate complete candidate and preserve an exact parent binding; classify narrowing versus successor revision explicitly.

evaluation_binding: Explicit proposed Definition/v2 preparation checklist with the purposes of the existing foundation gates. The existing v1 evaluation profile names a v1 subject; it is not silently relabeled as v2.

fields.rule: Binding is explicit; original candidate labels are not current standing.
Never infer a Definition ID from concept_id, session_id or pack_id.
Renaming is visible; ambiguous complete export is not made a global alias.
Preserve the original wording and record every reviewed clarification.
A prose statement is not a proof; optional formal-expression null requires an explicit reason in preparation metadata.
Set normative=false and preserve exact scope.

fields.input_or_selection: pack context + explicit application explanation and examples
fields.rule: Set normative=false; context text alone is not a complete domain voice.

fields.input_or_selection: current role assignment + exact authority scope
fields.rule: Do not derive ownership or principal identity from owner_route.
Pack context and request consumer do not grant authority scope.

fields.input_or_selection: candidate boundary + formal and domain exclusions
fields.rule: Explicitly preserve coverage versus accuracy, exclusivity and permission distinctions.
Preserve source digest, selector, standing and exact source-admission reference; candidate evidence is not promoted.

fields.input_or_selection: pack, context envelope, language checks and exact supplementary files
fields.rule: Evidence is distinct from admitted governing premise sources.

fields.input_or_selection: pack consumer plus resolved intended consumer records
fields.rule: An agent label alone is not an exact Work or Evaluation reference.
Do not mutate live current_lookup while preparing.

fields.input_or_selection: explicit accountable owner, audit and challenge route
fields.rule: Resolve applicability rather than copying a display label.

fields.input_or_selection: selected canonical JSON and exact bound generator
fields.rule: One governing JSON, generated Markdown; no hand-edited second meaning.
Do not infer edges from parent refs, owner labels or same-pack membership.
Neither schema PASS nor scope confirmation implies owner review or admission.

owner_routes.evaluation_checklist: role:evidence-conformance-owner reviews the explicit Definition/v2 evaluation binding; evidence checks do not promote meanings
owner_routes.external_source_admission: Applicable source-admission owner if an unadmitted governing premise is required
owner_routes.incident_applicability: incident-commander is a proposed example domain reviewer, not an admitted semantic-owner assignment
owner_routes.local_operator: Exact provisioned local operator; cannot acquire repository definition-owner authority from a key or store configuration
owner_routes.representation_mechanics: role:artifact-mechanics-owner reviews field mapping, schema and generator mechanics; does not promote meanings
